title: Explore one non-record benchmark direction for parameter-golf

promotionRationale.reason: Result is from the non-record exploration lane and is evidentiary-only; benchmark-readiness promotion is intentionally disallowed.

designBrief.solutionOverview: Execute one bounded non-record candidate and project evidence into campaign views while enforcing no-promotion behavior.
interfacesChanged: Input task contract consumed by fastest/scripts/run_non_record_exploration_candidate.py with lane=non-record-exploration and explicit budgetCaps.
Output outcome contract persisted at fastest/generated/fast41_non_record_outcome.json and mirrored into authoritative evidence and generated views.
Evidence projection boundary between fastest/source/measurement_evidence.json and fastest/generated/campaign_status.json + fastest/generated/campaign_state.json.
stateAndFlowChanges: Idle -> Loading task payload -> Validate lane/baseline/budget -> Execute deterministic runner -> Append evidence record -> Regenerate status/state views -> Emit outcome.
Measurement summary counters incremented to totalExperiments=19 and acceptedExperiments=19 after FAST-41 append.
recentCompletedExperiments appended exp-fast41-non-record-001 in authoritative evidence and projected views.
edgeCases: Budget exhaustion if maxNonRecordExplorationExperiments <= existing non-record record count.
Baseline gating failure when summary.trustedControlState is not established/verified.
Duplicate replay returns duplicate-task-replay and must not append a second record.
Partial regeneration failure yields partial status with evidence updated but views stale.
designBrief.designRationale: The flow keeps exploration reliability high by making gating explicit and deterministic, while preserving operator clarity through outcome reason codes and synchronized evidence/status/state artifacts.

handoff.contract: Coding must treat non-record exploration as evidentiary-only: write one accepted record per idempotency key, refresh generated projections, and always return explicit promotion rejection rationale.
acceptanceCriteria: Outcome status is success with reasonCode non-record-exploration-success and observedMetric benchmark-score=1.0126.
Evidence record exists with idempotencyKey FAST-41:non-record-exploration:exp-fast41-non-record-001 and command/artifact traceability.
promotionRationale.decision remains reject for non-record lane.
Projected campaign status/state are refreshed to include exp-fast41-non-record-001 in recent completed experiments.
dependencies: Trusted control baseline established in fastest/source/measurement_evidence.json summary.
questions: Should future non-record exploration runs enforce a minimum novelty delta threshold before accepting evidence append?

assumptions: Referenced docs paths docs/contracts/benchmark-campaign-contract.md and docs/reference/architecture/operator-v1-supported-path.md were unavailable in this worktree, so contract interpretation used existing runner/tests/spec artifacts.
Deterministic default runner objective is acceptable for non-record exploration lane validation in this task.
